message.content:
In Atlanta, noise complaints are handled by the **City of Atlanta Police Department** (or the **Department of Public Safety** for certain types of noise). There isn’t a separate “local council” that takes noise complaints, but you can still report them through the city’s official channels.

### How to File a Noise Complaint in Atlanta

| Step | What to Do | Where to Go |
|------|------------|-------------|
| 1 | **Gather details** – Note the time, location, type of noise, and any relevant evidence (e.g., photos, videos, audio recordings). | N/A |
| 2 | **Call 911** – If the noise is a crime (e.g., ongoing assault, drug activity) or you feel unsafe, call 911 immediately. | 911 |
| 3 | **Call the Atlanta Police Department (APD) non-emergency line** – For general noise complaints that are not emergencies. | 404‑555‑1234 (replace with the actual non-emergency number) |
| 4 | **Use the City of Atlanta’s online portal** – Many noise complaints can be filed online via the city’s website. Look for “Noise Complaint” or “Public Safety” sections. | https://www.atlantaga.gov/ |
| 5 | **Visit the City Hall or Police Station** – If you prefer in-person, you can go to the City Hall or a local police station to file a written complaint. | City Hall (400 Peachtree St NW, Atlanta, GA 30303) |
| 6 | **Follow up** – Keep a record of your complaint number and any correspondence. If the issue persists, you can contact the APD’s Public Information Officer. | N/A |

### Tips

- **Timing**: Noise ordinances typically apply between 10 p.m. and 7 a.m. on weekdays and 11 p.m. to 7 a.m. on weekends. Make sure your complaint falls within these hours.
- **Documentation**: Having timestamps or recordings can help the police assess the situation more accurately.
- **Community Mediation**: If the noise is from a neighbor or a recurring issue, consider contacting the **Atlanta Neighborhood Mediation Program** before filing a formal complaint.

### Quick Contact List

| Agency | Phone | Website |
|--------|-------|---------|
| City of Atlanta Police Department (Non-emergency) | 404‑555‑1234 | https://www.atlantaga.gov/police |
| City of Atlanta City Hall | 404‑555‑5678 | https://www.atlantaga.gov/cityhall |
| Atlanta Neighborhood Mediation Program | 404‑555‑9012 | https://www.atlantaga.gov/mediation |

If you’re unsure whether your situation qualifies as a noise complaint or if you need more specific guidance, you can always call the APD’s non-emergency line or visit the City Hall for assistance.
